objectives_fil: Sa sitwasyon ni Ben, mag-alok ng makatotohanang pagpipilian at kumpirmahin ang napiling hakbang, responsable at oras ng pag-follow-up.
objectives_en: Given Ben’s situation, offer realistic options and confirm the chosen action, responsible person and follow-up time.

sections.takeaway_fil: Alamin ang alalahanin bago pumili ng tugon.
sections.takeaway_en: Find out the concern before choosing a response.

sections.takeaway_fil: Gamit ang action card, mag-alok ng dalawang makatotohanang paraan ng pag-follow-up kay Ben. Ipasabi kung alin ang nais niya.
sections.takeaway_en: Using the action card, offer Ben two realistic follow-up options. Ask which he prefers.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ito ay tiyak na gawaing kayang gawin nang hindi nangangako ng appointment.
sections.takeaway_en: This is a concrete action without promising an appointment.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi pa alam ni Salma ang iskedyul. Ano ang maaari niyang ialok kay Ben?
check.prompt_en: Salma does not know the schedule yet. What can she offer Ben?

options.fil: Itanong sa health center at magbalita sa takdang oras.
options.en: Ask the health center and update him at an agreed time.

options.fil: Mangakong may staff kahit anong oras siya dumating.
options.en: Promise staff will be available whenever he arrives.

options.fil: Ipalagay na hindi interesado si Ben sa serbisyo.
options.en: Assume Ben is not interested in the service.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Ito ay tiyak na gawaing kayang gawin nang hindi nangangako ng appointment. 2: Hindi pa kumpirmado ang availability ng staff. 3: Hadlang sa oras ang sinabi ni Ben, hindi kawalan ng interes.
check.feedback_en: 1: This is a concrete action without promising an appointment. 2: Staff availability has not been confirmed. 3: Ben described a time barrier, not a lack of interest.

sections.takeaway_fil: Itinatala ang piniling hakbang, taong kikilos at oras; kinukumpirma ang pagpili ni Ben at hindi tinatawag na appointment ang update.
sections.takeaway_en: Records the chosen action, responsible person and time; confirms Ben’s choice without presenting an update as an appointment.

sections.takeaway_fil: Humingi ng tulong sa tamang tao kapag lampas sa saklaw.
sections.takeaway_en: Seek the appropriate support when a situation exceeds your role.

sections.takeaway_fil: May hakbang, responsable at oras na puwedeng kumpirmahin kay Ben.
sections.takeaway_en: This has an action, owner and time to confirm with Ben.

check.prompt_fil: Pumayag si Ben na magtanong muna si Salma. Aling pagtatapos ang pinakamalinaw?
check.prompt_en: Ben agrees that Salma will first ask. Which closing is clearest?

options.fil: “Sige po, hintayin na lang natin ang mangyayari.”
options.en: “All right, let us wait and see what happens.”

options.fil: “Pumunta na po kayo bukas; bahala na ang staff.”
options.en: “Just go tomorrow; staff will deal with it.”

options.fil: “Magtatanong ako at tatawag bukas ng alas-dos.”
options.en: “I will ask and call tomorrow at two.”

check.feedback_fil: 1: Walang nakatalagang kilos o oras ng pagbalita. 2: Ginagawa nitong appointment ang hindi pa kumpirmadong usapan. 3: May hakbang, responsable at oras na puwedeng kumpirmahin kay Ben.
check.feedback_en: 1: No action or update time is assigned. 2: This turns an unconfirmed discussion into an appointment. 3: This has an action, owner and time to confirm with Ben.

sections.takeaway_fil: Pumili ng isang hakbang at balikan ang naging resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Choose one action and follow up on the result.
